snippet.title: Harvest Moon 64 - Nintendo 64 (N64)
snippet.description:
Gameplay video of Harvest Moon 64 for Nintendo 64 (N64). I take care of my animals, pick and water my vegetables, go fishing, walk around town, greet my neighbors, give an offering to the goddess, and  then end my night at the beach in this iconic farming/life sim game.

Revisiting HM64 (blog entry): https://www.jvgs.net/blog/2016/03/08/harvest-moon-64/
